name: Cinematic presentation and README
description: It is projected on a large screen. Dark theme, large type, an opening title, an always-visible synthetic-data disclaimer, and a README that lets anyone run it in one minute. Polish is last and must not touch src/engine/.

userStories.title: Dark cinematic layout in styles.css
userStories.description: Body background #05070d, text #e8eef7, system font stack (-apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif). Layout: CSS grid, full viewport height, no page scroll. The particle field canvas fills the left 60% of the width; the right 40% stacks the statistics panel above the chart canvas; controls sit in a bar along the bottom. #age and #alive use font-size clamp(48px, 6vw, 96px) and font-weight 700; #pct and #extra use clamp(24px, 2.5vw, 40px). Buttons are 48px tall with 8px radius, #1c2a3f background, white text.
acceptanceCriteria: At 1920x1080 the #alive figure is at least 64px tall and there are no scrollbars
At 1280x720 nothing overlaps and every control is clickable

userStories.title: Opening title and disclaimer
userStories.description:
Add
1,000,000 LIVES
positioned over the field canvas, centred, font-size clamp(64px, 10vw, 160px), letter-spacing 0.08em. On Play it transitions opacity to 0 over 600 ms then gets display:none. Reset shows it again. Add
Synthetic mortality assumptions for illustration only. Not for real actuarial use.
fixed at the bottom, 14px, 70% opacity, always visible.
acceptanceCriteria: The title is visible on load and invisible within 1 second of pressing Play
The disclaimer is visible at 1920x1080 and 1280x720

userStories.title: README.md and ENGINEERING_LOG.md
userStories.description: Write README.md with these headings in this order: What this is; The maths (the l(x+1) formula, the improvement formula, the terminal-age convention); Run it (python3 -m http.server 8080, then the URL); Test it (node --test tests/); Regenerate the table (node tools/generate-table.mjs, then python3 tools/reference.py); Disclaimer. State in What this is that the particle field is a display of the engine's numbers and introduces no randomness into the calculation. Write ENGINEERING_LOG.md with one entry per PRD FEAT-001 to FEAT-005: date, decisions taken, test command and result, known limitations.
acceptanceCriteria: A new reader can run the app and the tests from README alone
README contains the sentence about the particle field and the engine
ENGINEERING_LOG.md has five entries, one per PRD
